notes: *seemeth* is assigned to the fused בְּ + עֵינַיִ on the model of rule 40's `אִם־רַע בְּעֵינֶיךָ` → *if it displease thee*, no other English word standing for either morpheme; the competing reading, giving it to טוֹב as rule 20's linking copula and marking both morphemes unrepresented, is named in the unit note.
The substantival article takes the supplied *what* (rule 41); both infinitive-construct suffixes take the English subject pronouns written for them (rule 18).
*gave ... suck* heads on the complement under rule 44.
